en.question: When extended thinking is enabled, how do thinking tokens relate to billing and the output limit?

options.text: They are billed as output and consume budget inside max_tokens.
They are billed as input tokens, since they precede the visible answer.
options.note: They are generated rather than supplied, so they are not input.

options.text: They are billed at the discounted cache-read rate for reused reasoning.
options.note: Cache-read pricing applies only to reused input prefixes.

options.text: They are not billed at all and do not count toward max_tokens.
options.note: Assuming they are free is a common cause of unexplained cost overruns.

en.explanation: Reasoning tokens are generated tokens, so they are priced as output and sit inside the response budget. That is why budget_tokens must be set below max_tokens and why thinking raises both cost and latency.
